description:
Create the crate-jmap-testjig/ directory with publish=false Cargo.toml, bare src/lib.rs and src/main.rs stub, and wire in dependencies: axum, tokio (with rt-multi-thread + macros + signal), tokio-tungstenite (with rustls-tls per workspace TLS-stack convention), all 8 workspace server crates (jmap-{mail,chat,calendars,tasks,contacts,filenode,sharing,metadata}-server) with their 'memory' feature enabled, plus jmap-server foundation and the reference MemoryBackend implementations.

Per the workspace TLS-stack convention (see workspace AGENTS.md), tokio-tungstenite MUST be declared with default-features=false and only rustls-tls-* features enabled. Do not add native-tls / openssl / default-tls.

## Out of scope

- Any axum routes (slice .2 / .3 / .4 / .5 / .6)
- Any spawn_in_process helper (slice .7)
- Any doc / README (slice .8)

The main.rs at this slice just compiles to an empty binary; lib.rs is a single placeholder module. Workspace add to Cargo.toml workspace.members.

## Acceptance

- crate-jmap-testjig/ directory exists with publish=false
- cargo check --workspace -p jmap-testjig clean
- cargo clippy -p jmap-testjig -- -D warnings clean
- No transport / handler / route code yet (placeholders only)
- 'cargo tree -i openssl --workspace' continues to report 'did not match any packages' (TLS-stack policy guard)
title: Scaffold crate-jmap-testjig (Cargo.toml, lib.rs, main.rs stub, dep wiring)
